objective: Determine locally whether lc-direct-neural-core/1 guarantees that every autonomous fixed or pointer action realizes a complete valid UTF-8 sequence and whether the host rejects invalid bytes before the declared output boundary.

probes.tokenizer_action_atomicity: Split the valid character using the exact v1 tokenizer, realize each resulting action separately, and strictly decode each result as UTF-8.
probes.combined_roundtrip_control: Realize the full ordered action sequence and require exact U+201C roundtrip.
probes.host_boundary: Give the exact v1 host a fixture module returning one invalid byte and record whether generate rejects it before returning.

decision_rule: If either action atomicity or host fail-closed validation fails, mark v1 UTF-8 output conformance failed while preserving the original construct scope. Any repair must be a separately versioned post-release interface; do not edit sealed model/runtime files or relabel old artifacts.
claim_boundary: This audit can establish only local v1 UTF-8 conformance or a bounded host/action-surface gap. It cannot assess ABI acquisition, English quality, teacher parity, or performance.
